rows.ARS:
Dark red Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: Fryclimbdown
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 1990).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 1991 as 'Crimson Cascade'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Glossy, light green foliage.

Height: 6'7" to 9'10" (200 to 300cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Participated in the 1990 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
Apuldram's Roses say this rose has dark red blooms with a velvety texture...
